'''Arkuda''' was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Arkuda system/Legends|Arkuda system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] connected Arkuda to the [[Gulvitch system/Legends|Gulvitch system]] and the [[Vallusk Cluster/Legends|Vallusk Cluster]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] traveling along the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route frequently stopped at the Vallusk Cluster to recalibrate their [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] prior to making the jump to Arkuda. Arkuda was also linked by the [[Korphir Trace]] to the [[Korphir system/Legends|Korphir system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Situated near the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] known as [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]], Arkuda was known for its spectacular [[Local day/Legends|nighttime]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Arkudan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arkuda was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
